item.title: Eileen Franklin Testimony Led to a Conviction Later Overturned
item.description: Eileen Franklin said a recovered childhood memory implicated her father in the 1969 murder of her friend Susan Nason. Her testimony helped convict George Franklin in 1990, but trial errors led to the conviction being overturned in 1995. Prosecutors dropped the case in 1996.

item.title: Natascha Kampusch Escaped While Her Captor Took A Call
item.description: Abducted at ten in Austria in 1998, Natascha Kampusch endured more than eight years in captivity. In August 2006, she escaped while cleaning her captor’s vehicle after he stepped away to answer his phone. DNA confirmed her identity, and she reunited with her family.
